mechanism: Bell eats counter: BECv1 tm10 with E1 = 1LB. A binary counter in 3-cell blocks (1/0 digits, f filler) eats tm10's unary run. Each phi-eat (EAT1/EAT0z) shifts the grid one cell (1->f, 0->0, f->s). The s blocks are flushed by CARRY_S, which in phase C adds e_i at bit p_i of the old value. The flush is a fresh counter: while s remain, the part right of the rightmost s has value t (increments since the eat), and the flush takes F = 2^(1+D_F) increments. Non-halting needs F <= N (epoch length) at every phi-eat. Chains of f-start words close by C0-C5, given the S1 bound L9. L9 reduces to one arithmetic case (H: exact carries PC = 2^D + sparse Y with N < 2^(D+1)); #28 is #10 mirrored and started in E, the orbits merge by epoch 350,328, and #10's counter-family breaks L9 and the flush from states that satisfy every local invariant: pseudo-random arithmetic (ground rule 6).

model.flush_counter: L1: while s remain, value(right of rightmost s, with b) = t; CARRY_S unrolled: X' s^e Y -> inc(incC^e X') f^e Y0
model.flush_time: L2: F = 2^(1+D_F), D_F = Q - popcount((val(U) + sum_{i<r} e_i 2^p_i) mod 2^Q); Q = digits right of the leftmost f of U
model.post_flush: L3: v(W,b) = t = m; filler pattern on U's digit positions = binary PC = val(U) + sum_i e_i 2^p_i (1 = f)
model.budget: L4: v(W,b) <= m for the rest of the epoch; hence N >= 2 val(U) at EAT1 and N >= 4 val(U) at EAT0z
model.generic_bound: L5: U starts with 1 => F <= 2^(1+Q) <= 2^d <= 2 val(U) <= N

model.S1_S2: S1: U starts with digit 1; S2: U starts with f. For S2: Y = val + sigma - e 2^D, c = Y div 2^D, P = Y mod 2^D, F = 2^(1+zeros(P)).

model.C3_capacity: no overflow in epoch k => 2^(Z_k) <= N_k (S1 via L9; S2 with c = 1 via Z_k = 1 + zeros(P_k) and F_k <= N_k).
model.C4_shape: every S2 word is f 1 ... with c <= 2 (c = 0 or 2 => the next word starts with 1).
model.C5_chain: F <= N at every S2 phi-eat: cut previous epoch => F <= 2^(Z_k) <= N_k < N_{k+1}; uncut => not bottom exact (val(U_{k+1}) > val(U_k)).
model.L9_open: S1 bound PC(U) = val + sigma < 2^(D+1); used by C3, C4 and last stage's L7; not implied by the state invariant alone.
